This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

3. The present Writ Petition has been filed with the following prayer:-
" It is, therefore humbly prayed that, the Hon'ble Court be graciously pleased to admit this writ petition, issue a Rule Nisi, And called on the opposite parties to show cause as to why opposite parties shall not be directed to make transfer/reference petitioner's objection regarding sufficiency of amount of compensation U/S 64 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 filed in L.A Case No.29 of 2012 to the court of Presiding Officer, LAR & R Authority, Odisha, Cuttack.
And in the event of opposite parties do not show any cause or show insufficient cause then after hearing the petitioner this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to allow this petition and direct the opposite party no.4 to move the reference u/s. 64 of the act afresh before the P.O LAR & R Authority, Cuttack within a specific time limit in the interest of justice and equity.

1 pleased to direct any other just and appropriate relief to the petitioner in the interest of justice and equity.

And the Hon'ble Court may be pleased to pass any further order/orders, writ/writs and direction/directions against the opposite parties and allow any other relief/reliefs in favour of the petitioner to which the petitioner is legally entitled to but has not specifically prayed for in this writ petition.
And for this act of kindness the petitioner as on duty bound shall ever pray".
4.

In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting her grievances, the Petitioner has made a representation to Opposite Party No.4 vide Annexure-7 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time, to which learned Counsel for the State has no objection.

5. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.4 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-7, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
Issue urgent certified copy as per Rules.
(DR. B.R. SARANGI) JUDGE Arun/Subrat (B. P. SATAPATHY) JUDGE Usharani Das vs State Of Orissa & Others
